Root Cause: Kafka broker is throttling the producer due to a quota limit on the client API key. Pod logs show broker throttle times of 2.8-3.0 seconds, producer queue at 96% full, and consumer lag of 31.2+ million messages growing continuously. Scaling replicas didn't help because the bottleneck is at the broker quota level, not the application throughput.

Fix: Contact the data platform team to increase the Kafka producer quota on your client API key.
